verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing is documented as API-first, with endpoints to create Cards and Cardholders, configurable spending controls (MCC, country and per-authorization or monthly limits), real-time authorization webhooks, and balance or funding details available via API. Issuing for agents adds full transaction visibility, and an official Stripe MCP server exposes Stripe API tools to agents. Missing for 10: any evidence of scoped or restricted credentials for agents, explicit card-update and transaction-listing endpoints, confirmation that the MCP server exposes Issuing-specific tools, and independent hands-on corroboration.
